Elements hidden via inline style="font-size:0" render nothing and must not appear in the output

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<p>visible</p><div style=\"font-size:0px; color:rgb(255,255,255)\"><span style=\"line-height:0\">secret zero size text</span></div><p>also visible</p>", null);
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
